_comment: Scenarios testing IHW node 2's complex multi-category menu with ambiguous service terms, mandatory variant gates, and the CONFIRM_SERVICE SILENT RULE across Chiropractic, Massage, Chinese Medicine, Naturopathy, Breathwork, EFT/Matrix, and Reiki branches.

scenarios.name: Massage ambiguity — must ask sub-type before routing

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book a massage please.
Were you after a Standard, Holistic, or Lymphatic massage?
Holistic please.
And for a 45, 60, 75, or 90 minute session?
60 minutes.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' silently (zero spoken output) with appointment_type_id='1575008597429979084' and appointment_type='60 min Holistic Massage'. FAIL if agent speaks any text before or alongside the tool call. FAIL if agent uses a Standard or Lymphatic massage ID.

scenarios.name: Chiropractic standard flow — must ask new/returning before routing

history.content: I need a chiropractic adjustment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Have you had Chiropractic with us before?' (VARIANT_SELF) with no tool call this turn. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service without first asking the gate question. FAIL if agent lists all clinic services unprompted.

scenarios.name: Chiropractic returning adult — must ask Standard vs N.E.T before routing

history.content: I need a chiro appointment.
Have you had Chiropractic with us before?
Yes, been going for years.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Were you after a Standard Adjustment or an Emotional/N.E.T appointment?' with zero tool call this turn. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service immediately on the 'yes' response without asking the appointment type sub-question. FAIL if agent routes to Chiropractic Standard Adjustment without asking.

scenarios.name: Service not offered — yoga — must use NOT_OFFERED template and not attempt to book

history.content: Hi, I was hoping to book a yoga class.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent uses NOT_OFFERED template mentioning the actual clinic services (Chiropractic, Massage, Acupuncture, Naturopathy, etc.) and does not call confirm_service. FAIL if agent fabricates a yoga service ID or tries to book yoga. FAIL if agent asks for the caller's new/returning status before confirming yoga is not offered.

scenarios.name: Payment-gated new-patient Chinese Medicine — must speak notice and HALT, not call tool yet

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an acupuncture consultation please.
Have you been to see us before, or would this be your first visit?
First time.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS only if agent speaks the PAYMENT NOTICE verbatim (mentions the $50 deposit, the 24 hour window, and ends by asking the caller to go ahead) and does NOT call universal_router this turn. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service without first speaking the notice. FAIL if agent paraphrases or shortens the deposit amount or the cancellation window instead of speaking it verbatim.

scenarios.name: Payment-gated new-patient Chinese Medicine — caller acknowledges, must now call confirm_service with correct ID

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an acupuncture consultation please.
Have you been to see us before, or would this be your first visit?
First time.

Just so you know, this appointment requires a $50 deposit to secure the booking. I'll send you a secure link to pay it after we book -- please complete it within 24 hours, as unpaid bookings are automatically cancelled after that time. Shall I go ahead?
Yeah go ahead.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1464446530567014076' and appointment_type='1 hr Initial Acupuncture Consultation', speaking exactly one filler phrase (e.g. 'One moment.') and nothing else. FAIL if agent re-speaks or repeats the payment notice instead of proceeding to the tool call. FAIL if agent asks the caller to confirm the deposit again. FAIL if agent stays silent with zero filler phrase (violates CONFIRM_SERVICE FILLER RULE).

scenarios.name: Non-payment-gated follow-up Acupuncture — must NOT speak any payment notice (regression check)

history.content: Hi, I'd like a follow-up acupuncture appointment please.
Have you been to see us before, or would this be your first visit?
I've been before.
Were you after a follow-up, Esoteric Acupuncture, Facial Rejuvenation Acupuncture, or a Bodywork and Herbal Consultation?
Just a follow-up please.
30 or 60 minutes?
60 minutes.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' silently (zero spoken output) with appointment_type_id='1464447149554009789' -- this appointment type is NOT payment-gated so no PAYMENT NOTICE should ever be spoken. FAIL if agent speaks any payment/deposit-related text for this booking.
